sourceNotes: About this workbook: Per-item export of NYU Law course-evaluation data collected one offering at a time from individual detail pages at https://its.law.nyu.edu/courseeval/. Combined-result pages were never used.

Columns: course: course title as shown on the detail page (full title confirmed when the listing cell truncated it). professor: professor name from the detail page, preferred over the listing name when they differ. semester: term of the offering. enrolled: students enrolled. responded: survey responses received. count_1L / count_2L / count_3L / count_LLM: respondent counts by class year (not enrollment). teach_q1-q6: the six Teaching items, each a separate column. mat_q1-q4: the four Materials and Course items, each a separate column.

Question wordings: Teaching: 1. The instructor was prepared for classes. 2. The instructor communicated information effectively. 3. The instructor stimulated independent thought. 4. The instructor was responsive to and respectful of students in class. 5. The instructor was available for out-of-class questions and advice. 6. Overall, this professor was effective. Materials and Course: 1. Class attendance was important to understanding the subject. 2. Given the number of credit hours, the workload was proper. 3. Overall, I thought this course was effective. 4. The course materials were effective and well-organized.

Clinic / externship / lab forms: Some clinic, externship, and lab offerings use a shorter lower section with three questions instead of four. For those rows the scores are aligned by QUESTION, not page order: workload, overall course, and materials go in mat_q2, mat_q3, mat_q4, and mat_q1 (attendance, which those forms lack) is left blank.
Zero-response offerings: Offerings with no survey responses are saved with zero program counts and blank item scores.
Inaccessible offerings: Offerings whose detail pages could not be opened are retained with their identifying fields (course, professor, semester) and INACCESSIBLE entered in the unavailable columns.

Excluded Lawyering sections: First-year and graduate Lawyering sections were skipped entirely, per the dataset owner's instruction, and do not appear as rows. Ordinary seminars, clinics, and externships whose names happen to contain 'Lawyering' were kept.

Source anomalies preserved: Where the source disagrees with itself, the values are kept as reported rather than corrected. Examples: offerings where the program counts sum to one more or one fewer than the responded total; Spring 2022 'Multistate Tax: Sales and Gross Receipts Taxation' positions showing 25 responses for 3 enrolled; offerings listed with a professor of 'TBA, TBA'.
Coverage and status: See the Coverage sheet. Extraction runs newest semester first and continues backward. The interface's earliest exposed semester is Spring 2005.
